entries.title: Romans 9:1
segments: ¶I tell the truth in Christ, I am not lying, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Romans 9:2
segments: that I have great sorrow and continual grief in my heart.

entries.title: Romans 9:3
segments: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my countrymen according to the flesh,

entries.title: Romans 9:4
segments: who are Israelites, to whom [pertain] the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service [of God], and the promises;

entries.title: Romans 9:5
segments: of whom [are] the fathers and from whom, according to the flesh, Christ [came], who is over all, [the] eternally blessed God. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 9:6
segments: ¶But it is not that the word of God has taken no effect. For they [are] not all Israel who [are] of Israel,

entries.title: Romans 9:7
segments: nor [are they] all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, "In Isaac your seed shall be called."

entries.title: Romans 9:8
segments: That is, those who [are] the children of the flesh, these [are] not the children of God; but the children of the promise are counted as the seed.

entries.title: Romans 9:9
segments: For this [is] the word of promise: "At this time I will come and Sarah shall have a son."

entries.title: Romans 9:10
segments: And not only [this], but when Rebecca also had conceived by one man, [even] by our father Isaac

entries.title: Romans 9:11
segments: (for [the children] not yet being born, nor having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works but of Him who calls),

entries.title: Romans 9:12
segments: it was said to her, "The older shall serve the younger."

entries.title: Romans 9:13
segments: As it is written, "Jacob I have loved, but Esau I have hated."

entries.title: Romans 9:14
segments: ¶What shall we say then? [Is there] unrighteousness with God? Certainly not!

entries.title: Romans 9:15
segments: For He says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whomever I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I will have compassion."

entries.title: Romans 9:16
segments: So then [it is] not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy.

entries.title: Romans 9:17
segments: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "For this very purpose I have raised you up, that I may show My power in you, and that My name may be declared in all the earth."

entries.title: Romans 9:18
segments: Therefore He has mercy on whom He wills, and whom He wills He hardens.

entries.title: Romans 9:19
segments: You will say to me then, "Why does He still find fault? For who has resisted His will?"

entries.title: Romans 9:20
segments: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed say to him who formed [it], "Why have you made me like this?"

entries.title: Romans 9:21
segments: Does not the potter have power over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel for honor and another for dishonor?

entries.title: Romans 9:22
segments: [What] if God, wanting to show [His] wrath and to make His power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

entries.title: Romans 9:23
segments: and that He might make known the riches of His glory on the vessels of mercy, which He had prepared beforehand for glory,

entries.title: Romans 9:24
segments: [even] us whom He called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

entries.title: Romans 9:25
segments: ¶As He says also in Hosea: "I will call them My people, who were not My people, And her beloved, who was not beloved."

entries.title: Romans 9:26
segments: "And it shall come to pass in the place where it was said to them, '[You are] not My people,' There they shall be called sons of the living God."

entries.title: Romans 9:27
segments: Isaiah also cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, The remnant will be saved.

entries.title: Romans 9:28
segments: For He will finish the work and cut [it] short in righteousness, Because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth."

entries.title: Romans 9:29
segments: And as Isaiah said before: "Unless the LORD of Sabaoth had left us a seed, We would have become like Sodom, And we would have been made like Gomorrah."

entries.title: Romans 9:30
segments: ¶What shall we say then? That Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness of faith;

entries.title: Romans 9:31
segments: but Israel, pursuing the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 9:32
segments: Why? Because [they did] not [seek it] by faith, but as it were, by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumbling stone.

entries.title: Romans 9:33
segments: As it is written: "Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and rock of offense, And whoever believes on Him will not be put to shame."
